processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Geometry-optimized crystal structure via first-principles DFT using CASTEP; GGA-PBE exchange-correlation, ultrasoft pseudopotentials, 8×8×8 Monkhorst-Pack k-point mesh, 450 eV plane-wave cutoff, energy converged to 2×10⁻⁶ eV and forces below 0.5 eV·nm⁻¹.

structures.overall_structure: Cubic supercell structure with space group Pm-3m (B2-type FeAl parent), Mn substituting Fe on the Fe sublattice; 16-atom cell (8 Al + 8 Fe/Mn sites); Fe0.375Mn0.625Al has 5 Mn and 3 Fe on the Fe/Mn sublattice; DFT-optimized lattice parameter a = b = c = 0.580 nm.

phases_present.crystal_structure: cubic, space group Pm-3m (B2-derived), a = b = c = 0.580 nm

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: First-principles DFT computed values (CASTEP, GGA-PBE), not experimental measurements

magnetic_properties.magnetic_character: magnetic characteristics due to dissymmetric spin-up and spin-down DOS

computational_details.simulation_method: Spin-polarized first-principles density functional theory (DFT) with GGA-PBE exchange-correlation and ultrasoft pseudopotentials; plane-wave basis.
computational_details.potential_model_or_database: GGA-PBE exchange-correlation; ultrasoft pseudopotentials; valence states Fe 3d⁶4s², Mn 3d⁵4s², Al 3s²3p¹.
computational_details.boundary_and_initial_conditions: Monkhorst-Pack 8×8×8 k-point mesh; 450 eV plane-wave cutoff; total energy converged to 2×10⁻⁶ eV; forces reduced to 0.5 eV·nm⁻¹; cubic supercell Pm-3m.
computational_details.validation_against_experiment: Calculated lattice parameters show good agreement with other experimental and calculated values (Table 1).

analytical_models.equation_role: Compute polycrystalline bulk modulus B, shear modulus G, Young's modulus E and Poisson's ratio σ (Eqs. 4-9).
Mechanical stability check: C11-C12 > 0, C11 > 0, C44 > 0, C11+2C12 > 0 (Eq. 3).
Universal anisotropic index A^U, anisotropy A_B and A_G, and shear anisotropic factors A1=A2=A3 (Eqs. 11-14).

analytical_models.model_name: Debye temperature and sound velocity formulas
analytical_models.equation_role: ΘD, vm, vl, vs computed from density and moduli (Eqs. 15-18).

unmapped_findings: Elastic constants (Table 2, Fe0.375Mn0.625Al): C11 = 230.1 GPa, C12 = 151.1 GPa, C44 = 134.7 GPa (b0049).
Elastic moduli (Table 2, Fe0.375Mn0.625Al): bulk modulus B = 176.5 GPa, shear modulus G = 86.1 GPa, Young's modulus E = 222.2 GPa, Poisson's ratio σ = 0.290, B/G = 2.05 (b0049).
Mechanical anisotropy (Table 3, Fe0.375Mn0.625Al): universal anisotropic index A^U = 1.73, anisotropy A_B = 0, A_G = 0.148, shear anisotropic factors A1 = A2 = A3 = 3.41 (b0051).

Thermodynamic stability (Table 1, Fe0.375Mn0.625Al): lattice parameter a = b = c = 0.580 nm; cohesive energy E_coh = -6.824 eV·atom⁻¹; formation enthalpy ΔH_f = -0.328 eV·atom⁻¹; both negative, indicating thermodynamic stability (b0021, b0019).
Ductility: B/G = 2.05 (> 1.75) for Fe0.375Mn0.625Al, so it is classified as ductile (b0045).

Electronic structure (Fig. 3f, Fe0.375Mn0.625Al): nonzero DOS at Fermi level (metallic); sharp Fermi-level peak from hybridized Fe-d/Mn-d states with weak Al-p; oscillating low-amplitude DOS beyond ±5 eV; asymmetric spin-up/spin-down channels (magnetic) (figure_003, b0025, b0028).
Bonding: combination of covalent and metallic bonds (electron density maps), giving good electronic conductivity, high melting points and high hardness (b0029, b0030).
